title: Which of the game's glows suits taking over a pawn?
intro: Stand next to your main pawn, camera on them. Press End (or click both sticks) to start.

steps.text: Look at your MAIN PAWN (stand close, camera on them). The next steps light them up with 7 of the game's own glows, 4 s each, A to G. Press End when they're in view.
A: the Riftstone glow pawns get (PawnRimStone). Does the main pawn glow?
steps.each_frame:
local function rims()
  local ch = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.PawnManager'):call('get_PawnCharacterList'):call('get_Item', 0)
  local rm = ch:call('get_GameObject'):call('getComponent(System.Type)', sdk.typeof('app.MaterialInterpolationRequestManager'))
  local l = rm:get_field('MIRimLightList'); local t = {}
  for i = 0, l:call('get_Count') - 1 do t[#t+1] = l:call('get_Item', i) end
  return t
end
local function hash(n) return sdk.find_type_definition('app.MIRimLightHash'):get_field(n):get_data(nil) end
local function set(n, on)
  local h = hash(n)
  for _, mi in ipairs(rims()) do pcall(mi.call, mi, on and 'requestMaterialMode(System.UInt32, System.Int32, System.Int32)' or 'finishMaterialMode(System.UInt32, System.Int32, System.Int32)', h, 0, 0) end
end
if G_prev_off ~= 'A' then G_prev_off = 'A'; set('PawnRimStone', true) end
